unavailable: Integration unavailable. No approved provider is configured.
hint: Browser hint only; not hardware verification.
conflict: HX-1004: Manual selection conflicts with browser hint. Clear selection and check console settings.
unsupported: HX-3003: Offline API unavailable; online mode only.
ready: Shell files are present in browser cache. Offline device testing is still required.
failed: HX-3001: Cache preparation or verification failed. Retry with connectivity.
invalid: Enter an exact version such as 9.00; values are never rounded.
empty: No matching records. No compatibility is inferred.
catalogNote: Catalog r1 · 2026-11-15. Historical package references only. No firmware or model has been verified. Offline copies cannot receive immediate withdrawals.
noComponents: No approved downloadable components. Third-party integration requires rights, provenance and hardware evidence.
cacheHelp: Only original host assets are cached. Shell readiness does not establish HEN or component readiness. After preparation disconnect, reopen, and navigate to verify your device. Legacy application cache is not enabled without device evidence.
systemHelp: Only browser-visible properties are shown. Model, privileges and native runtime are unknown.
diagHelp: Logs contain bounded error codes only. Reports stay local until you choose to share them. Client timestamps are untrusted.
resetConfirm: Reset only HYPEHOSTX preferences and logs? Browser cache and other site data are not changed.
recoveryHelp: Close this page after a browser crash and reopen the reviewed host. Do not retry an unconfirmed provider operation automatically. Clear browser site data manually only after understanding it may remove other stored data.
sessionOnly: HX-4003: Storage unavailable; preferences last for this session.
updateUnknown: HX-6001: Available release is unknown. No firmware changes are performed.
sameVersion: Metadata reports the installed version. This is not a signed publisher update.
guideText: Start with Firmware Library. A browser hint or manual selection is not proof of compatibility. HYPEHEN shows integration availability honestly. Prepare the original offline shell only when your browser supports it. No account is required. Native applications require an existing authorized runtime.
changelogText: 0.1.0-dev — Original local information-host implementation. Target release: 1.0.0. No stable release or hardware support is claimed.
creditsText: Original implementation: MR.4NONY / NEXORAID. Upstream references retain their own authors and names. No upstream code or binaries are bundled. Original license awaits owner decision.
aboutText: HYPEHOSTX is an independent information host. HYPEHEN is the launcher UI, not a verified native enabler. No Sony or upstream endorsement. No ads, tracking, mandatory accounts, or cloud calls.
documentation: Upstream documentation only; no downloadable component or verified support.
